subject: Ultimately Pointless
author: ZombieTron
body:
Hi,

The only thng you get in the Ultimate Box which you have to pay for as DLC if you have the standard version of Burnout Paradise is the Party Pack.

As you can purchase the Party Pack as DLC anyway, the ultimate box is ultimately pointless.

The standard version of Burnout Paradise is all you need as long as you have your Xbox hooked up to the internet as you get the bikes as free DLC and the rest of the DLC you have to buy anyway (except Party Pack which is included in the ultimate box)

It probably is region free if you are dead set on getting the Ultimate box version tho. Hope this helps! 🙂
